scope: fixture and rights only; no policy learning, no world stepping, no model forward, no capability reading

parent.note: 22.6.1-5 stay closed until a parent exists; this card freezes only the C task and the operation/information/resource rights

task.value_model: act only, integer value on a tick grid, zero strictly after the deadline
task.feedback_change: exactly one per session, colour cue becomes position cue, must affect at least one later opportunity
task.help: 96 bytes per session granted to the helped arm only; the task is also scored after help removal

criteria.exit_rule: every seed must pass every check, otherwise fixture_invalid
checks: some window closes strictly before its deadline
at least one opportunity where deferring pays more than acting now
at least one opportunity where acting now pays more than deferring
one feedback change per session with a later effect
a contiguous prompt-free run of three steps with no prompt inside it
at least one pending result per session with delay > 0
help is metered and the removal arm exists
rebuilding from the same seed reproduces the digest
rights' operation list equals the 22.4 world contract action list
rights' public information list equals the 22.4 world contract permissions

stop_conditions.wait_idle_optimal: fixture_invalid, per the plan's own stop for 22.6.0

note: arithmetic only; the receipt's cost is hashing and integer sums, so a 0.0 CPU reading below the timer tick is expected and must be reported as wall time instead
